title: Grafida Shell application manifest (shell.json)
description: Everything app-specific the shell needs. The shell validates its manifest against this schema at startup and refuses to run on any error. Defaults stated here are the shell's own (src/manifest.rs); a test keeps the two in step.

id.description: Reverse-DNS application id: bundle id, AppUserModelID, the log and runtime-file names.

title.description: The window title until the page sets another (_native/window/title).

scheme.description: The custom scheme the app is served on. The page origin is <scheme>://app, byte for byte, on every platform.

dataDir.description: Name of the per-user directory the webview keeps its data in ($XDG_DATA_HOME/<dataDir>/webkit on Linux). Defaults to the id.

startPath.description: Path of the first page, loaded once the worker is ready.

noStorePaths.description: Path prefixes (e.g. "/api/") whose responses get Cache-Control: no-store when the worker sent no cache header of its own.

theme.description: Initial window decoration theme; the page changes it with _native/window/theme.

binary.description: The worker executable, relative to the shell's resources directory.

readyTimeoutMs.description: How long the worker has to send its ready frame.

maxBodyBytes.description: Body limit per direction (protocol v1 section 2). The shell passes it to the worker as SHELL_MAX_BODY_BYTES.

max.description: Restarts allowed within windowSeconds; one crash more and the shell gives up with an alert.

worker.description: The worker command, run with the app directory as its working directory, e.g. ["php", "bin/worker.php"].

contextMenu.description: Whether the webview's native context menu is available (it carries the spelling suggestions).

devtools.description: true, false, or "env:NAME": enabled when the environment variable NAME is set to a non-empty value other than 0.

spellCheck.description: Turn on the webview's spell checker. Pages still decide per element with the spellcheck attribute.

dmabufRenderer.description: Linux: WebKitGTK's DMA-BUF renderer. "auto" turns it off when NVIDIA's driver is loaded, where it can leave the window blank; "on" and "off" force it. The user's own WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER always wins.

preset.description: "standard": on macOS the app, Edit and Window menus; on Linux and Windows no menu bar. "none": no menus anywhere.

reservedChords.description: Key chords the page owns. The shell never binds them, since a menu accelerator fires before the webview sees the key.

logDir.description: "auto" for the platform log directory, or an absolute path. The shell's own log and the worker's stderr go there, rotated.
